controlled_variable: Authored U-turn center x=-45 m away from the x=-20..20 m intersection versus x=0 m inside it; road, actor, camera and candidate policy fixed within each pair
authored_geometry: 6 m radius semicircle from outer eastbound lane center y=-6 m to outer westbound lane center y=+6 m on a six-lane road with 4 m lanes; centerline crossing and heading reversal recorded at 20 Hz

fallback_triggers.fallback1: Measured requested approach speed above 4 m/s; slower 3 m/s approach
fallback_triggers.fallback2: Original synchronized pixel review missing; elevated overview camera
fallback_triggers.fallback3: Fewer than 40 pre-turn stationary frames or original reversal proof missing; two-second pre-turn dwell

original_required: Generated road and intersection topology and continuous physical U-turn lane-crossing readback
Observed physical body footprint and heading reversal at 20 Hz with synchronized original pixels
Source-hashed human review of U-turn location and centerline crossing
Independent territorial/business-district designation and exception applicability review
limitations: Authored type=town and district flag do not prove a statutory business district
An authored intersection zone does not prove the express intersection exception or divided-highway opening
Synthetic heading and crossing are request diagnostics only; no legal verdict or accepted recording
